# FPSOT decisions specification

> What software must record and prove about each individual administrative decision that it makes or helps make, whatever the engine: decision types with jurisdiction profiles and impact levels, a plain decision contract with four result kinds, bitemporal rule versions with dated parameters, an append-only decision record aligned with PROV-O, factor-named reason codes with counterfactual values, notices rendered at notice time, human review steps gated by impact level, events without personal values, and a conformance suite for every rule provider.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, roles, the capability boundary, legal status and conformance; DEC-001 to DEC-006.
- [Jurisdiction profiles](spec/en/profiles.adoc): DEC-010 to DEC-014.
- [Decision contract](spec/en/contract.adoc): DEC-020 to DEC-028.
- [Rule versions and effective dates](spec/en/rule-versions.adoc): DEC-030 to DEC-038.
- [Decision records](spec/en/records.adoc): DEC-040 to DEC-048.
- [Reasons and explanations](spec/en/reasons.adoc): DEC-050 to DEC-058.
- [Human review](spec/en/human-review.adoc): DEC-060 to DEC-066.
- [Interfaces and events](spec/en/api-events.adoc): DEC-070 to DEC-073.
- [Testing and conformance](spec/en/testing.adoc): DEC-080 to DEC-086.
- [Rules as code maturity](spec/en/maturity.adoc): informative.
- [Questions for counsel](spec/en/questions-for-counsel.adoc): informative, not legal advice.
